title: Vampire Vape Fat Gob Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Savour an everlasting taste sensation with Vampire Vape’s Fat Gob, a delightful medley of fruits inspired by the colossal Gobstoppers that are synonymous with lively and colourful British fairgrounds. Just as captivating as the scrumptious sweetshop confection, this flavour continues to enchant your taste buds without the worry of numbing your mouth or breaking teeth from chomping on gigantic Gobstoppers. Embrace the sugary delight of Fat Gob, an e-liquid that promises a whirlwind of fruit candy flavours that will keep you coming back for more. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
